description: This file manages brand image operations including saving, retrieving, and deleting the brand image in a Mattermost server application.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct with methods to handle brand image operations.

methods.name: SaveBrandImage
methods.description: Handles uploading and saving a new brand image, including backup of the old image.

methods.name: GetBrandImage
methods.description: Retrieves the current brand image as a byte array.

methods.name: DeleteBrandImage
methods.description: Deletes the current brand image file.
